Subject: Post-promotion manager: probation orientation & coaching plan

Hi team,

As discussed in last week's people sync, Sofia starts her manager probation window tomorrow (official promotion effective today). I want to make sure we have a short, targeted orientation for probation expectations plus a coaching plan focused on difficult conversations & performance calibration. Goals: set clear checkpoints for 30/60/90, ensure Sofia has resources for performance conversations, and confirm HR/legal sign-offs for any probation-related documentation.

Can we align on three things by EOD Wednesday?
- Aditya: confirm probation checklist and any paperwork HR needs signed (I attached the draft checklist).
- Lauren: propose 2x coaching workshop slots (60m) for "Difficult Conversations for New Managers" next week — one live, one recorded. Slides attached are a suggested starting point.
- Marcus: confirm whether we need an SLA with PeopleOps for escalations in the first 90 days and who to loop for casework.

Sofia — I'm looping you so you're aware. This orientation is supportive; we'll map concrete checkpoints and check-ins.

Thanks,

Priya Natarajan
Senior Engineering Manager, Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwood.ai
Attachment: probation_checklist.pdf
Attachment: difficult-conversations-slides.pptx

I reviewed the checklist and added a couple of items (probation goals doc, manager expectations ack). I also recommend we include the direct report lead for the 30-day checkpoint if that's ok.

I copied Olivia from Exec Coaches — she can run the 60m workshop and do a 30m 1:1 coaching offer for Sofia (optional, billed to team training budget). Olivia: are you able to do Wed live and provide the recording?
